purpose: Wave-5 residual pack A: high-value permanent skilling unlocks still missing as first-class ids in data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json after wave-4 critical tools and related fills. Targets Karamja Papa Mambo shop depth, Oo'glog spa permanent, crystal utility-tool residual (chisel/knife/saw/binding rod), Crafteneering first-class method, dwarven army axe, ironman enchanted jewellery travel (skills necklace, combat bracelet, ring of duelling, dig site pendant, skull sceptre, games necklace residual package), and Legends Guild jewellery recharge. Skips ids already present (seedicide attach, bonecrusher-necklace stack, magical-thread, resource-dungeon package, spring cleaner, inferno adze, broad fletching Learn, Smoking Kills, crystal pick/hatchet/mattock, games necklace Burgh-only row, invention machines).

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed ABSENT from regional-skilling-unlocks.json before write. SKIP present: multi-region:toolbelt-seedicide-attach, forinthry:seedicide-named, cross-region:bonecrusher-necklace, forinthry:magical-thread-abyss-supply, forinthry:resource-dungeon-unlocks, asgarnia:spring-cleaner, asgarnia:inferno-adze, multi-region:slayer-broad-fletching, desert:smoking-kills-slayer-points, morytania:games-necklace-burgh-teleport, tirannwn:crystal-pickaxe/hatchet/mattock, prifddinas:crystal-tool-workshop, cross-region:crystal-tools-dragon-base, asgarnia:invention-guild-machines-named, cross-region:invention-machines-guild, morytania:endurance-relic (Archaeology Endurance only — not the spa pools).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change travel, Habitat seed economy, spa run-energy QoL, early multi-tool XP, Crafting AFK, or crystal artisan tools.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, effects, and shop stock only.
policy.rs3_terminology: Oo'glog spa is quest-permanent pool access (As a First Resort), distinct from Endurance relic. Crystal utility tools use crystal tool seed + harmonic dust — not the dragon-base pick/hatchet/mattock path. Dwarven army axe is reclaimable permanent multi-tool; cannot toolbelt.

activity_additions.name: Papa Mambo's Shop (Herblore Habitat)
activity_additions.category: permanent Habitat ironman seed and supply shop
requirements: Herblore Habitat access (south-east Karamja; no quest gate)
Coins for stock (vine herb seeds 10,000 each; juju teleport spiritbags 2,000; blossom seeds 50)
unlocks: Ironman-buyable vine herb seeds (erzille, ugune, argway, shengo, samaden) — post-16-March-2026 stock caps accumulate over seven days to 35 each (was 5)
Blossom seeds (red/blue/green) and marasamaw plants for Habitat attraction setups
Juju teleport spiritbags for Habitat teleports without witchdoctor mask
Juju vials/packs, plant cure, and farming tools for Habitat loops
Witchdoctor robes/legs appear in stock at 0 for reclaim pricing after outfit D&D awards
region_pressure: Hard Karamja: shop is at Habitat next to Papa Mambo; juju production and witchdoctor D&D claim stay on the same site.
activity_additions.notes: karamja:herblore-habitat and juju-farming-potion-path only footnote the shop. This row is the ironman seed-top-up + spiritbag checklist after the 2026 dailyscape stock-cap change. Do not invent seed drop rates from jadinkos.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Karamja for Habitat shop access.

activity_additions.name: Oo'glog spa pools (As a First Resort)
requirements: As a First Resort completed (Feldip Hills / Oo'glog)
48 Hunter, 51 Firemaking, 58 Woodcutting (boostable where allowed)
Ironman spear/chompy logistics as wiki quest ironman notes
unlocks: Permanent access to five spa pools (Bandos, sulphur, salt-water, thermal, mud) — effects stack when all bathed
Salt-water spring: unlimited run energy for 9–24 minutes (3-minute steps; re-roll by re-entering); Anachronia tier-3 base-camp spa multiplies duration 1.5×
Thermal bath life-point heal; sulphur prayer restore above base; mud Hunter camouflage boost; Bandos combat aggressiveness reduction
Ogre flask bottling of pool effects; Oo'glog bank and charter-ship destination
Robust glass / crystal glass machine path and Teplin Macagan flask decanting (5–6 dose flasks)
region_pressure: Kandarin: Oo'glog / Feldip Hills quest site and spa geography (near Warforge / South Feldip spirit tree).
Anachronia optional: base-camp spa tier-3 extends salt-water duration only — does not unlock the quest pools.
activity_additions.notes: Distinct from morytania:endurance-relic (Archaeology Endurance power from Warforge Smoky Fings — infinite run while harnessed). Spa is the quest-permanent pool package ironmen use for Farming runs, RC, and beacon lines before Endurance. Do not invent pool durations beyond wiki bands.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin for As a First Resort and Oo'glog pools. Tag Anachronia only for spa-duration upgrade planning.

Smuggler leather buy + Crafting leather-body loop inside floors
Membership for full DG floors (free-to-play subset exists at lower efficiency)
unlocks: Repeatable Crafting XP inside Daemonheim via smuggler leather → leather items (ironman AFK Crafting path)
Rusty coin side-economy for dungeon supplies
Planner-visible method distinct from surface tanners / Invention hide tanner
region_pressure: Hard Forinthry: Crafteneering is the Daemonheim smuggler loop — not a TzHaar or Karamja supply chain.
activity_additions.notes: Earlier enrichment only shipped forinthry:crafteneering-boundary as an anti-row in the Karamja pack and it never entered research. This is the first-class method row. Do not invent XP/hour.

equipment_additions.name: Dwarven army axe
equipment_additions.category: permanent early multi-tool and flat XP tool
requirements: Claim from Major Mary Rancour at Burthorpe training camp (free; no tutorial path required post-10-July-2023)
Alternate historical path: To Lumbridge achievement path reward
Cannot be added to the tool belt — must be carried or equipped to apply bonuses
effects: Functions as bronze hatchet, bronze pickaxe, chisel, tinderbox, needle, and low-tier slash weapon in one item
+3 base XP on listed Mining/Crafting/Cooking/Hunter/Woodcutting/Firemaking/Fletching actions while wielded or in inventory (stacks multiplicatively with other XP boosts)
Overrides toolbelt hatchet/pickaxe while equipped even if a higher-tier tool is belted
Normal-tree wooden knot chance and copper/tin lapis lazuli side-products for early jewellery
Free reclaim from Major Rancour if lost
region_pressure: Hard Asgarnia: Burthorpe claim/reclaim NPC.
equipment_additions.notes: Permanent ironman early-game multi-tool. Do not invent XP/hour from the flat +3. Higher-tier hatchet/pick should replace it for gather rate; keep for Fletching arrow-batch XP quirks and pottery-wheel clay moulding.

equipment_additions.name: Crystal utility tools (chisel, knife, saw, binding rod)
equipment_additions.category: permanent crystal artisan tool residual package
requirements: Plague's End / Prifddinas access for Ithell singing bowl path
Crystal tool seed + 150 harmonic dust + 80 Smithing (or pay Ilfeen/Eluned/Islwyn/Rhodri Dail coin enchant without dust)
The Eyes of Glouphrie for player singing path; Roving Elves for NPC enchant path
Seeds degrade to crystal tool seed and re-enchant on a declining coin ladder (7,500 → 1,500 minimum)
effects: Crystal chisel: 2% chance extra cut gem (excludes onyx/hydrix/moonstone); doubles Crafting Shattered Heart rock chance when not gem-cutting
Crystal knife / crystal saw (Prifddinas) / crystal binding rod: artisan Crafting/Construction/Runecrafting tool upgrades from the same seed family
Charge-based tools (not the non-degrading dragon-base crystal pick/hatchet/mattock path)
Closes residual gap after gather tools (pick/hatchet/mattock) and hammer/rod/tinderbox already first-class
region_pressure: Hard Tirannwn for Prif singing / NPC re-enchant geography and harmonic dust economy.
equipment_additions.notes: User residual 'attuned crystal tools' maps to this seed-sung utility set — RS3 crystal gather tools are not 'attuned' (attuned is weapon/armour/teleport seed tier). Do not re-emit pick/hatchet/mattock/hammer/rod/tinderbox rows.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Tirannwn for conversion and re-enchant.

equipment_additions.name: Skull sceptre
equipment_additions.category: permanent unlimited Stronghold of Security travel tool

Combine right/left skull halves + top/bottom of sceptre drops from minotaurs, flesh crawlers, catablepon, ankou

Varrock armour worn increases part drop chance

Early ironman free travel near Edgeville / Grand Exchange / Varrock west bank
One assembled sceptre at a time (unless keepsaked); parts still drop while owned
